title: Anyscale Connector values
description: Constrains the values that must be supplied, and the set of top-level keys. Contents below the top level stay unrestricted, so overrides are free-form; a key at the wrong level is not, because Helm would otherwise ignore it silently and render the chart default.

cloudResourceId.description: The cloud resource this connector serves (cldrsrc_...).

tag.description: Anyscale release tag. Every Anyscale-built image in this chart follows it unless its own image.tag is set.
